description: Revoke BeautyOS access for the resolved memberId while retaining the employee and calendar. Requires members.manage and beautyos.members.write. Returns a saved change ID with exact recipient, role, calendar and email effects. No access changes or email before confirmation. Show the effects and call beautyos_apply_change only after explicit approval. Ownership changes and self-role changes are forbidden; external CRM/legacy permissions are unchanged. If a receipt reports accessSaved=true and deliveryError, tell the user the invitation email failed and propose a new confirmed resend; replaying the original operation never resends.
name: beautyos_member_revoke_prepare
title: Revoke access
